The '''Dononter Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dononter sector/Legends|Dononter sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dononter Minor]].
